mapper.select: SELECT id, account, password_hash, created_at, updated_at FROM user_account WHERE LOWER(account) = LOWER(#{account})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (account, password_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{account}, #{passwordHash}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT account, CASE WHEN LOWER(account) = LOWER(#{query}) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isExactMatch FROM user_account WHERE LOWER(account) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') AND LOWER(account) <> LOWER(#{excludeAccount}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(account) = LOWER(#{query}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(account), account LIMIT #{limit}
